packageRules.description: Optical-ripper (ARM) image: process bumps immediately. Each new MakeMKV release bundled by ARM resets the ~60-day beta window, so staying current keeps the ripper registered between releases. The key (permanent or rotated free beta) remains the backstop for quiet stretches >60 days -- see archiver-rmj.

Automerge ARM patch+minor bumps (Flux deploys on merge). Major bumps fall through to the rule above: prompt, top-priority PR but NOT automerged -- a human gates breaking ARM upgrades on the one workload with physical hardware.
